title: Day 12: The Quiet
body: It’s too quiet. Even the crickets are gone. We’ve been sleeping in trees. I saw a group of "changed" in the meadow below. They don't walk anymore; they lurch in a rhythmic, terrifying twitch. They seem to be communicating through a low, guttural clicking. Clara says she hears them in her sleep. I haven't closed my eyes in forty hours.
